what_this_is: the age of a value at the moment it reached this record: the time between the end of the measurement window the source stated and our reception of it. It contains the publisher's own delay AND up to one of our polling intervals, and this record cannot separate the two. It is not a measurement of the publisher alone, and it is not a quality score.

Rows keep the label as received; phenomenonTimeCorrected/resultTimeCorrected are our ESTIMATE (minus 2 h) and are marked so. Re-check after the clocks change on 2026-10-25.
S146.what_this_source_publishes: this source's rows are on more than one clock (corrected, measured): rows collected before its clock note was written carry only the label, later rows carry our corrected estimate beside it. Ages on two clocks are not one distribution and are not blended into one; see age_by_clock.
